summary: Lantronix Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $30 million in common stock under a sales agreement with Needham & Co. and Canaccord Genuity. The stock trades on Nasdaq (LTRX) at $5.83 per share. Sales will be made at market prices, with agents receiving 3% commission. There is no escrow or minimum sale requirement. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
